login.title: Sign in
login.mfaHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

errors.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unavailable: The Core is not reachable. Try again shortly.
errors.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.allGood: Every agent is compliant and reporting.
dashboard.noAudit: Your role does not cover the audit trail.
dashboard.name: Name

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.subtitle: Customers or environments you can reach. Each has its own agents, policies, secrets and artifacts.
tenants.name: Name
tenants.denied: Your roles do not cover this section.
tenants.secretsNote: Names only: values are write-only and never shown.
tenants.archiveHelp: The tenant disappears from the console and the API, its enrollment keys, tokens and role assignments are revoked, and its tenant-owned content sources stop. It must have no agents. The audit trail and policy history are kept and the name stays reserved.
tenants.confirmArchive: Type the tenant name "{name}" to archive it.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} across the tenants you can reach.
agents.name: Name

policies.denied: Your roles do not cover this policy.

proxies.title: Proxies
proxies.subtitle: Branch-office relays. Agents behind a proxy reach the Core through it.
proxies.name: Name
proxies.denied: Your roles do not cover proxies.
proxies.keyOnce: Enrollment key for {name} (shown once, valid 24 hours, single use):
proxies.confirmDelete: Type the proxy name "{name}" to delete it.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Append-only and hash-chained. Newest first.
audit.denied: Your roles do not cover the audit trail.
audit.chainEvents: {count, plural, one {# event verified} other {# events verified}}

editor.denied: Your roles do not let you write policies in this tenant.
editor.draftNote: It will be a draft until approved.

keys.title: Enrollment keys
keys.shownOnce: Copy this key now: it is shown only once.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.note: Write-only: values are sealed on the Core and never shown again. Saving an existing name replaces its value.
secrets.name: Name

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Local and single sign-on accounts, and the roles they hold per tenant.
users.denied: Your role does not cover user management.
users.confirmDelete: Type the user name "{name}" to delete it.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Built-in roles are fixed; custom roles are composed from the permission matrix.
roles.denied: Your role does not cover role management.
roles.name: Name
roles.confirmDelete: Type the role name "{name}" to delete it.
roles.matrixHelp: Tick the actions the role grants; "all" grants every action of the resource, including future ones. Tenant roles cannot hold platform-wide permissions.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Security settings of {name}.
profile.mfaScan: Add the account to an authenticator app with this secret (or the URI below), then enter the code it shows.
profile.recoveryOnce: Recovery codes (shown once; each works one time in place of a code):
profile.tokensDenied: Your role cannot create API tokens.

access.title: Access and approval
access.none: No role assignments in this tenant.
access.confirmRemove: Remove all roles of {name} in this tenant?
access.approvalHelp: new policy versions need a second person to approve them before they go live

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.subtitle: OpenID Connect providers and how their groups map to roles. Local sign-in stays available according to the Core configuration.
sso.denied: Your role does not cover single sign-on settings.
sso.name: Provider
sso.mappingsHelp: A user gets the role of every group they belong to, in the tenant given (or globally). Roles from this source are replaced at each sign-in; manual assignments are not touched.
sso.confirmDelete: Type the provider name "{name}" to delete it.
sso.requireMapping: Refuse sign-in when no group maps to a role

content.title: Content sources
content.subtitle: Directories or git repositories that own policies and artifacts. A source owns what it created: the API refuses edits to those objects.
content.denied: Your role does not cover content sources.
content.name: Name
content.confirmDelete: Type the source name "{name}" to delete it.
content.ownershipHelp: A platform source may write to any tenant it lists; a tenant-owned source can touch only its tenant. Owner and kind cannot be changed later.
content.locationDir: Folder under the Core content directory
content.poll: Sync every N seconds (min. 30, empty = on demand)
content.prune: Remove objects that disappear from the source
content.historyHelp: Every sync attempt, with what it changed.

agentAdmin.title: Agents
agentAdmin.name: Name
agentAdmin.confirmDelete: Type the agent name "{name}" to delete it. The host will no longer be served.
